bootstrap_method: 95% percentile patient-cluster bootstrap, resampling patients within each outer fold. All images of a sampled patient stay together. Single-class draws in any fold are excluded from all metrics and comparisons. Intervals are conditional on these fitted models, selected recipes, fixed folds and observed fold memberships; no retraining or recipe reselection is performed. They omit training variability and prior pilot adaptivity.
development_caveat: Development OOF evidence after earlier architecture, augmentation and recipe pilots; fold 0 also has archived exploratory results. Independent outer prediction within this run does not erase earlier adaptation to this development dataset. The locked test remains necessary after decisions are frozen.
score_interpretation: Raw sigmoid scores; class weighting can distort probability scale. No fitted calibration or tuned decision cutoff.
pooled_caveat: Pooled AP mixes scores from independently fitted models; mean fold AP is primary because fold score scales may differ.
